posts.text: It's time for Halloween, so I have a challenge for you: survive Leetcoding with this Chrome extension that transforms your grind into a spooky IDE! This weekend I attended the first ever Hack-or-Treat at the University of Toronto, hosted by UofTHacks, which was 7 hours of code-fueled frights and Halloween delights. We brewed up plenty of drinks, debugged in the dark, and embraced the ghoul old spirit of rapid prototyping. Why trick or treat when you can trick and tweak? 👻 Presenting: CodeScare I

Had the incredible opportunity to travel to Harvard University and hack at HackHarvard 2025. It was an amazing experience building a project to help people with disabilities express their creativity through accessible 3D modeling. I couldn’t have done it without my amazing teammates, learn more about LookSmith below! 👏

Travelled 12hrs by bus from Toronto to John Hopkins University for HopHacks 2025, and it was worth every second. 🚌✨ We built GiftFlow: 🤝 Connect donors with verified charities automated by Google Gemini's API 📝 Automate tax-deductible donation receipts 🚀 Streamline the entire giving experience, end-to-end This philanthropic project meant a lot to me, every gift can spark real change and empower communities. 🌍✨ I would definitely be expanding this idea into something truly special.💡 Big love to s

Had a great time mentoring at Hack the 6ix! Big shout-out to Divjot Singh for joining me in guiding students through their projects. Loved meeting Praveen Narendran from QNX, who showed me how their tech powers real-time systems in the auto industry, and Advait Maybhate from Warp, who gave me insights into building faster developer workflows.
